_doc: cmux-next perf budgets (perf-budgets.py). A frame budget is one 120 Hz frame (8.33 ms) between presented frames during a motion; a latency budget (input to the committed frame that shows its result) is two 120 Hz frames (16.7 ms). CPU rows are percent of one core. Patterns are full-match regexes over row names; the first match wins. floor: the smallest p95 change the gate counts as a regression (noise).

panes\\..*\\.frame.what: split, close, New Column, zoom: frame interval during the motion

sidebar\\.\\d+\\.(scroll|scroll_while_ti.what: sidebar scroll at N workspaces, with and without agents ticking

cmd_n\\..*.what: Cmd-N: key to new workspace visible

cmd_t\\..*.what: Cmd-T: key to new tab visible

ctrl_backtick\\..*.what: Ctrl-`: key to new terminal visible

tab_switch\\..*.what: tab switch: input to committed frame

palette\\..*.what: Cmd-Shift-P / Cmd-P: key-down to committed frame (p90)

sidebar\\.\\d+\\.workspace_switch\\..*.what: workspace switch from a sidebar click to idle

acp\\..*\\.typing\\..*.what: ACP chat composer: keydown to next frame / paint

sidebar\\.\\d+\\.ticking\\.cpu_pct.what: app CPU while agents tick in the sidebar
